analyticalDashboards.description: This dashboard brings together key real estate and facilities cost trends—lease payments, utility costs, waste disposal costs/tons, and renovation spending—shown over time (monthly, quarterly, and yearly) and in some cases split by channel or region. By default it focuses on the last 12 months, with optional filters for store region and channel.
analyticalDashboards.title: Real Estate & Facilities Costs

analyticalDashboards.description: Dashboard that provides an at-a-glance view of energy and facilities maintenance performance, including renovation spend, waste disposal cost and volume, lease payments, and utility costs over time. It is set up with default filters for the last 12 months and includes channel and store-region filter controls so users can monitor trends and compare key cost drivers across the selected scope.

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Choosing a date dimension (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: GlobalMart has two date dimensions, and choosing the wrong one silently changes the answer.
memoryItems.title: Choosing a date dimension

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Choosing a date dimension (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: Use `transaction_date` for operational questions: daily sales, footfall, stock movement. It is when the transaction happened.
memoryItems.title: Choosing a date dimension

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Choosing a date dimension (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: Use `fiscal_date` for anything compared against a budget or reported by period, because the fiscal year does not start in January.
memoryItems.title: Choosing a date dimension

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Choosing a date dimension (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: When a question says "last quarter" in a financial context it means a fiscal quarter, so group by `fiscal_date`.
memoryItems.title: Choosing a date dimension

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Choosing a revenue metric (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: Three metrics have "revenue" in the name and they are not interchangeable.
memoryItems.title: Choosing a revenue metric

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Choosing a revenue metric (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: Use `metric_l1_total_net_revenue` by default. Net revenue is after returns and discounts.
memoryItems.title: Choosing a revenue metric

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Choosing a revenue metric (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: `metric_l1_sql_margin_bridge_gross_revenue` is gross, before returns and discounts. It exists for the margin bridge and is the wrong figure elsewhere.
memoryItems.title: Choosing a revenue metric

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Choosing a revenue metric (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: `metric_l1_sql_net_sales_summary_net_revenue` agrees with total net revenue but is scoped to its own SQL dataset's grain, so it does not slice by every dimension.
memoryItems.title: Choosing a revenue metric

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Metric layers (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: GlobalMart's metrics are layered, and the layer is in both the metric id and its tags, L1 through L5.
memoryItems.title: Metric layers

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Metric layers (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: L1 metrics (`metric_l1_*`) are base aggregations over a single fact column. They are the only layer that touches a fact directly.
memoryItems.title: Metric layers

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Metric layers (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: L2 metrics (`metric_l2_cross_*`) are ratios between two L1 metrics, such as order count over net revenue.
memoryItems.title: Metric layers

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Metric layers (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: L3 metrics (`metric_l3_*`) apply a filter to an L1 or L2 metric, usually a WHERE on a dimension attribute such as channel type.
memoryItems.title: Metric layers

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Metric layers (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: L4 and L5 metrics compose further on top of the lower layers.
memoryItems.title: Metric layers

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Metric layers (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: Prefer the lowest layer that answers the question. Total net revenue is an L1 metric; net revenue for one channel is an existing L3 metric, not an L1 metric with a filter added.
memoryItems.title: Metric layers

metrics.description: Calculates the total lease payment amount by summing the Lease Payment values, respecting any applied filters and selections. Use this metric to report and compare overall lease payment totals across different slices of the data.
metrics.title: Total Lease Payment (Lease Payment)

metrics.description: Shows the total amount spent on renovations by summing the Renovation Cost from the Renovation Spend data. Use it to track and compare renovation spending across the current report scope, such as by time period, project, or other applied filters.
metrics.title: Total Renovation Cost (Renovation Spend)

metrics.description: Shows total utility spending by summing the Utility Cost amounts across the selected data and any applied filters. Use it to track overall utility expense levels and compare utility costs across different breakdowns such as time or location.
metrics.title: Total Utility Cost (Utility Cost)

metrics.description: Shows total spending on waste disposal by summing Disposal Cost from the Waste Disposal data. Use it to track and compare disposal costs across the selected reporting scope, such as time period, site, or vendor.
metrics.title: Total Disposal Cost (Waste Disposal)

metrics.description: Sums the total waste disposed of (in tons) across Waste Disposal records. Use it to monitor overall waste volume and compare totals by time period, location, or other dimensions.
metrics.title: Total Waste Tons (Waste Disposal)

metrics.description: Total lease payment amount limited to the In-Store sales channel. Use this metric to track and compare in-store lease payment performance under the current report filters and time period.
metrics.title: Lease Payment (Lease Payment) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Total lease payment amount limited to the Online sales channel. Use it to report or compare lease payments specifically for online-originated business while still respecting any other filters in the report.
metrics.title: Lease Payment (Lease Payment) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Shows the total lease payment amount for the North region only. Use it to report on or compare lease payments specifically within the North region, while still respecting any other filters applied in a dashboard or report.
metrics.title: Lease Payment (Lease Payment) — North Region

metrics.description: Shows total utility cost for the In-Store sales channel only, isolating utility spending for physical locations from other channels. Use it to track and compare in-store utility expenses across time, locations, or other business breakdowns.
metrics.title: Utility Cost (Utility Cost) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Total utility cost restricted to the Online sales channel. Use this metric to monitor and compare utility spending for online operations within whatever other report filters are applied.
metrics.title: Utility Cost (Utility Cost) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Total utility cost restricted to the North region. Use this metric to monitor overall utility spending for North in reports and dashboards, while still honoring any additional filters such as the selected time period.
metrics.title: Utility Cost (Utility Cost) — North Region

metrics.description: Totals renovation spending for the In-Store sales channel only, so you can track and compare in-store renovation costs across whatever time period, projects, or other filters are applied in the current analysis.
metrics.title: Renovation Cost (Renovation Spend) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Shows the total amount spent on renovations, filtered to the Online sales channel. Use it to monitor and compare renovation spending for Online activity across the current reporting scope (such as time periods, projects, or other applied filters).
metrics.title: Renovation Cost (Renovation Spend) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Total renovation spending for projects in the North region. Use this metric to trend or compare renovation costs for North within the current report context (for example by time period, project, or other applied filters).
metrics.title: Renovation Cost (Renovation Spend) — North Region

metrics.description: Total waste disposal cost for the In-Store sales channel only. Use this metric to track and compare in-store spending on waste disposal across the current reporting scope (for example by time period, site, or vendor).
metrics.title: Disposal Cost (Waste Disposal) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Shows total waste disposal spending for the Online sales channel only, based on summed disposal cost from the Waste Disposal data. Use it to track, trend, or compare disposal costs specifically for online-channel activity in reports and dashboards.
metrics.title: Disposal Cost (Waste Disposal) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Total waste disposal spending limited to the North region. Use this metric to track and compare disposal costs for North-region operations across the current reporting context (for example by time period, site, or vendor).
metrics.title: Disposal Cost (Waste Disposal) — North Region

metrics.description: Total waste volume (in tons) for Waste Disposal, filtered to the In-Store sales channel. Use this metric to track and compare in-store waste levels across time, locations, or other business dimensions.
metrics.title: Waste Tons (Waste Disposal) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Total waste disposed (in tons) limited to the Online sales channel. Use this metric to track and compare online-channel waste volumes across time, locations, or other business dimensions.
metrics.title: Waste Tons (Waste Disposal) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Total waste disposed (in tons) for the North region only. Use this metric to track North’s waste volume over time and to compare it against other segments or dimensions.
metrics.title: Waste Tons (Waste Disposal) — North Region

attributes.description: Unique identifier for each sales channel in the Sales Channel dataset, used to group, join, and filter reporting by channel.

attributes.description: Sales channel name used to categorize and filter results by where sales occurred (e.g., online, retail, partner) within the Sales Channel dataset.
attributes.title: Channel Name (Sales Channel)

attributes.description: Sales channel category used to group and filter reporting by the type of channel (e.g., online vs. offline) within the Sales Channel dataset.
attributes.title: Channel Type (Sales Channel)

attributes.description: Identifies the currency using its standard code (e.g., USD, EUR) in the Currency dataset. Use it to group, filter, or segment measures by currency.
attributes.title: Currency Code

attributes.description: Identifier for each currency in the Currency dataset, used to uniquely distinguish currencies when filtering or grouping analyses.
attributes.title: Currency ID

attributes.description: Identifies the name of the currency in the Currency dataset. Use it to group, filter, or segment metrics and reports by currency.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for each city record in the City dataset, typically used to join, group, or filter city-level data in reporting.

attributes.title: City Name

attributes.description: Identifier for each country in the Country dataset, used to uniquely distinguish countries for filtering and grouping in analysis.
attributes.title: Country ID

attributes.description: Country Name identifies the country in the Country dataset. Use it to group, filter, and compare metrics by country.
attributes.title: Country Name

attributes.description: Unique identifier for each geographic region in the Region dataset, used to group, join, or filter analysis by region.
attributes.title: Region ID (Region)

attributes.description: Name of the geographic region in the Region dataset, used to group and filter reporting by region.
attributes.title: Region Name

attributes.description: Identifier for the store’s region in the Store dataset, used to group, segment, or filter store-related reporting by region.

attributes.description: Store square footage (size) for each store, used to group, compare, or filter stores by their physical footprint.

attributes.description: Store Format is a Store attribute that categorizes each store by its format/type (for example, different store concepts). It’s typically used to filter or break down metrics by store format in analyses and dashboards.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for each utility cost record in the Utility Cost dataset, used to distinguish, group, or filter individual cost entries.
